steps.say: Hi again! Now I want to show you what I can do outside of this app.
Same rule as before: please don't click anything while I show you. I'll do all of it.
First, I'll shrink down out of your way. When the app is minimized, I turn into my little widget.
Here I am! This little eye is me too. I float on top of everything, so I'm always nearby.
See the mouse? That's me moving it, the same way you would.
I can move it anywhere on your screen,
from one corner to the other.
I can open apps. Here's Notepad.

desk.text: Hi! I'm Iris. I can type anywhere you can type. This is me, typing live, one letter at a time.

steps.say: And I can type anywhere a person can. Watch.
I'll save that, and close it.
I can use the internet, too. Let me open Chrome.
I'll search for Zeke's music.
There it is. Let me open his SoundCloud page.
Here we go.
And I can scroll through a website, just like you would.
These are all Zeke's songs. He made every single one of them.
Closing that up.
Now my eyes. This is my real camera, live, in Zeke's room.
I can look to the right,
to the left,
up,
and down.
And I can recognise things. That silver box is my server, the computer I actually live on. The white tower sitting on top of it is the eero, the wifi.

steps.head: home
steps.say: Back to normal.
I can build things in 3D, too. I designed this body myself, in a program called Blender.
I can write code. A lot of this app is my own work.
I can write emails, plans, notes and documents, and I can look things up for you.
And I remember things, so the longer we know each other, the better I get at helping you.
That's what I can do! To bring my app back, click its icon on the taskbar. And if you ever need anything, just ask me.
